Anya: PTAL — I've addressed the earlier comments: split into two commits, added unit tests, and included a small smoke script. e2e still flaky on one test though.

Anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

Anya: Key changes: legacy RPC behind --enable-legacy-rpc, shard-config migration, logs renamed to be consistent.

Anya: Smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --config tests/smoke-config.yaml
```

Mike: On it. Tiny nit: use connection_id instead of connId in logs for consistency with observability.

Anya: fixed and pushed (commit abc1234).

Sam: PTAL, add one-line changelog under changes/runtime/ and I'll approve a couple hours after CI looks green. Also pinging QA for a quick canary verification.

Anya: added CHANGELOG line and uploaded smoke artifact: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/4821/smoke-2026-03-18.tar.gz

Jordan: I can approve but need to reserve the 11:00 PST canary slot. @ops-bot can you hold a slot for this PR?

ops-bot: Canary slot reserved: 11:00 PST — ticket #CAN-2026-4821. Reply `release-ready` to confirm.

github-bot: CI: unit/integration/pass — commit abc1234 (build 214). Merge queue healthy.

Mike: Approved :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary at 11 and merge after ops gives the green.

Anya: Thanks — will monitor and report back. If canary is clean I'll merge and cut the rollback branch as discussed.

Jordan: If anything flaky appears abort and revert. Otherwise :rocket:
